lines.speaker: celandine_marrowby
lines.text: A tally. How conscientious. The market carries many sacks; not every inconvenience is a scandal.
lines.direction: Smooth cultured alto, lightly amused elven lilt; never raises her voice.

options.label: These were seed sacks. Let the town have them.
We can read this tally aloud in the square.
We will take this to the mayor.

lines.speaker: celandine_marrowby
lines.text: Very well. A correction in the account, and the seed goes back. Do tell the town how generously these matters can be resolved.
lines.direction: Smooth cultured alto, lightly amused elven lilt; never raises her voice.

options.label: Witness the return of the seed.

lines.speaker: celandine_marrowby
lines.text: There. Written, witnessed, settled. Halden may pay your fee. I trust this concludes your errand.
lines.direction: Smooth cultured alto, lightly amused elven lilt; never raises her voice.

lines.speaker: celandine_marrowby
lines.text: An interesting performance. Bring me an account the mayor is prepared to sign, and we may speak again.
lines.direction: Smooth cultured alto, lightly amused elven lilt; never raises her voice.

lines.speaker: celandine_marrowby
lines.text: The lower fields are lovely from here. One sees so much more with a little distance.
lines.direction: Smooth cultured alto, lightly amused elven lilt; never raises her voice.

lines.speaker: celandine_marrowby
lines.text: The seed account is settled. Do try to find a less tedious subject.
lines.direction: Smooth cultured alto, lightly amused elven lilt; never raises her voice.

lines.speaker: celandine_marrowby
lines.text: Give Halden my regards. He is so attentive to small matters.
lines.direction: Smooth cultured alto, lightly amused elven lilt; never raises her voice.
